questions.q: if I just call the crate's one-line setup helper and never set RUST_LOG, what level do I end up logging at?
questions.why: DEFAULT_MAX_LEVEL is LevelFilter::INFO and try_init() falls back to a Targets filter with that default when RUST_LOG is absent

questions.q: my colored log output goes away when I pipe it into a file on CI - what is deciding to drop the color codes?
questions.why: the Default impl for the fmt Layer sets is_ansi from cfg!(feature = "ansi") && the NO_COLOR env var being unset/empty

questions.q: nothing shows up when I run my tests - how do I make the writer cooperate with the test harness capturing output?
questions.why: TestWriter's io::Write impl goes through print!/eprint! rather than a raw stdout handle so libtest can capture it

questions.q: does installing the global subscriber also pick up messages from dependencies that still use the old log crate?
questions.why: SubscriberInitExt::try_init/set_default install LogTracer and set log's max level from the current LevelFilter

questions.q: where is the default ISO-8601 wall-clock stamp on each line actually built, given the crate doesn't depend on chrono by default?
questions.why: time/mod.rs's FormatTime for SystemTime writes a DateTime, and datetime.rs holds the musl-derived epoch-to-civil-date math plus the Display impl

questions.q: can I ask a filter whether some module path and level would pass, without building a subscriber first?
questions.why: Targets::would_enable(target, level) delegates to target_enabled for exactly this

questions.q: if my directive names the crate root, does it also cover submodules underneath it, or only that exact target?
questions.why: Directive's Match::cares_about compares with meta.target().starts_with(target), i.e. prefix matching

questions.q: I have two overlapping directives that both match one event - what decides which level actually applies?
questions.why: StaticDirective's Ord sorts by target length then field count (reversed), DirectiveSet::add keeps the vec sorted, and enabled() takes the first match

questions.q: if one entry in my RUST_LOG string is garbage, does the whole filter blow up or just that entry?
questions.why: Builder::parse_lossy filter_maps failed Directive::parse calls and eprintlns 'ignoring ...', while Builder::parse returns the ParseError

questions.q: how do I only enable spans whose field has a particular value, and when is that value treated as a regex versus a literal?
questions.why: Match::parse splits name=value and picks ValueMatch::parse_regex vs parse_non_regex; MatchVisitor's record_* methods flip the matched flag

questions.q: adding a field-value condition to my filter seems to make every span get evaluated - why does that happen?
questions.why: EnvFilter::max_level_hint short-circuits to Some(LevelFilter::TRACE) when dynamics.has_value_filters()

questions.q: I want to change the filter while the process is running - what makes already-cached callsites notice the new setting?
questions.why: Handle::modify writes through the Arc<RwLock<L>>, drops the guard, then calls callsite::rebuild_interest_cache and resets log's max level

questions.q: my layer reads span data inside its close callback - what stops that storage slot being recycled before every layer has run?
questions.why: start_close bumps a thread-local CLOSE_COUNT and returns a guard whose Drop only clears the slab entry when the count hits the last frame

questions.q: if the same span gets entered twice on one thread, does exiting it once knock it off the current-span stack?
questions.why: SpanStack pushes a ContextId with a duplicate flag; pop returns !duplicate and iter() filters duplicates out

questions.q: two of my layers stash their own per-span state and now one of them panics on startup - what's the rule there?
questions.why: ExtensionsMut::insert asserts self.replace(val).is_none(), so a second insert of the same type panics

questions.q: is there an upper bound on how many independently filtered layers I can stack up?
questions.why: FilterId::new asserts id < 64 because FilterMap is a single u64 bitmap of per-layer decisions

questions.q: how do I walk a span's ancestors starting from the outermost one instead of the innermost?
questions.why: Scope's Iterator yields leaf-to-root; Scope::from_root collects into a (small)vec and reverses it

questions.q: with the JSON output, what happens to already-serialized fields when a span records an extra field after it was created?
questions.why: JsonFields::add_fields deserializes the stored string back into a BTreeMap, adds the new fields and re-serializes to avoid malformed JSON

questions.q: if an attacker gets terminal escape sequences into a logged string, can they mess with my console?
questions.why: escape.rs's EscapeGuard/EscapingWriter rewrite ESC, BEL, BS, FF, DEL and C1 chars; DefaultVisitor in format/mod.rs wraps message and error values in it

questions.q: when a span closes I get time.busy and time.idle on the line - where are those two numbers accumulated?
questions.why: a Timings extension inserted in on_new_span is updated by on_enter (idle) and on_exit (busy) using Instant, then emitted in on_close
